Issue Number: close #53111 

Problem Summary:

### What changed and how does it work?

PR includes 3 changes to reduce unnecessary TopN values:
1. Reduce the default TopN to 100 (from 500).
2. Support pruning of TopN values that are "not skewed" for smaller tables. 
3. And initially avoid adding values with a count=1 (which will be pruned anyway).

issue_context.title: TopN statistics are collected unnecessarily for non-skewed values on small tables
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Current ANALYZE will collect by default the top 500 values for an interesting column (indexed column or predicate column). For tables that are sampled, then there is pruning logic to remove statistics that are not skewed. For tables that are NOT sampled (smaller tables) - the pruning logic is not invoked.

Below shows an example where values are collected with a count of 1 - which are not skewed.

```
tidb> show stats_topn;
+---------+------------+----------------+-------------+----------+------------+-------+
| Db_name | Table_name | Partition_name | Column_name | Is_index | Value      | Count |
+---------+------------+----------------+-------------+----------+------------+-------+
| test    | t2         |                | a           |        0 | 73         |    16 |
| test    | t2         |                | a           |        0 | 74         |    16 |
| test    | t2         |                | a           |        0 | 75         |    16 |
| test    | t2         |                | a           |        0 | 76         |    16 |
......
| test    | t2         |                | a           |        0 | 101        |     1 |
| test    | t2         |                | a           |        0 | 102        |     1 |
| test    | t2         |                | a           |        0 | 103        |     1 |
| test    | t2         |                | a           |        0 | 104        |     1 |
......
```
comments: Do we already support the pruning TopN logic in small table (sampled table) ?

review_comments: Should we add some new test about the pruning logic in smaller table ? And check the topn number which has been pruned ?
Added a testcase to TestPruneTopN function in statistics_test.go
We should use a const variable. But because analyzeOptionDefaultV2 is not public, so I am OK with it.
Could you please explain why we changed the TopNNum from 500 to 100 in comments ?
@time-and-fate I think you need to take a look at this line's change

This looks good to me.
I checked the previous bad case and I believe the `int64(len(topns)) >= ndv` check should prevent that.
As for the change from `len(topns) == 0` to `len(topns) <= 1`, it looks like this won't bring a big behavior change.
But we may still need to be ready for possible regressions reported from the daily benchmarks or release tests.
Maybe we should add some comments to explain here we still try to ignore topn with count 1.
Do we need to add a case to check if we can prune `1` correctly?
